profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ford Motor Company
profile.summary: I have a BS in Computer Science from Michigan State University. I am currently working as a Full Stack Software Enginner for Ford Motor Company with the Global Prototype Inventory Requisitioning and Scheduling team.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained full-stack web applications for the Global Prototype Inventory Requisitioning & Scheduling (GPIRS) system at Ford Motor Company. Designed and implemented new features, including user interfaces, backend logic, and automated email notifications. Enhanced existing pages and workflows to improve user experience and streamline processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Full stack web development in a tech stack of React, TypeScript, and Java with Springboot. Updated, added, and tested features for online Commercial Line of Credit application and other webpages.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · TypeScript · React.js · Test-Driven Development · Pair Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Troubleshot known issues in the software. Added functionality and tested new features.

positions.title: Warehouse Associate
positions.description: Placed incoming packages onto shelves and logged their location into Amazon’s computer system.

positions.title: Assembly Line Worker
positions.description: Worked on an assembly line placing packages onto pallets to prepare them to be shipped out.

positions.title: Server
positions.description: Served food to guests at various events in my given section.

positions.title: Marketer
positions.description: Went door to door and attempted to convince people to pay for the company’s services.
